goals: Address gaps in the architectural/building-block options available in the modpack.
scope: Provide the Stone Parapet and Stone Louvered Shutter as two AMC blocks with matching items for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric.

Use the Macaw masonry block classes and model parents. The parapet maps vanilla Stone directly. The shutter uses the same Stone grain at matching UV coordinates, with structural lighting measured across the reference shutter's five repeated slats.

Provide Andesite, Diorite and Granite Buttons and Pressure Plates using the vanilla Stone controls, and Gothic Windows and Arrow Slits using the Macaw Stone Brick forms. Bind each material's vanilla sprite directly and preserve Macaw's glass and iron bars.

Provide Andesite, Diorite and Granite variants of BBB's Stone Column, Urn, Moulding, Fence and Frame using the provider classes, description items and original model hierarchies. Remap ten authored sheets independently for each material using its vanilla palette. Granite BBB textures use the eight interior colors of the luminance-ranked vanilla Granite palette.

Provide 13 Mud Bricks block/item pairs. Use Packed Mud directly for the two controls, four standard Macaw windows and parapet. Use Packed Mud grain with structural shading for the louvered shutter and its full palette for the five BBB masonry forms.

exclusions: Additional forms and materials, provider replacement, and IBF or BGE integration are outside this release.
